verdict.description: Routing verdict. Exactly one of the three enum values; the orchestrator routes on this field, not on the summary prose.

question_matched_verdict.description: The verdict in the terms the ticket asked (e.g. 'Discrepancy explained', 'No discrepancy'), plus how it maps to the routing verdict above.

evidence_complete.description: True only if every load-bearing claim is measured or traced. False forces EVIDENCE_INCOMPLETE.

working_as_intended.description: True only with positive evidence: the correct value decomposed, or a condition that precludes the reported behavior. An absent reproduction is not evidence.

disposition.description: The remedy the evidence supports, empty when the verdict is not DEFECT_PROVEN. 'both' is common and not a hedge: rate rows that are wrong AND applied wrongly need the migration and the proc change. 'unsupported at available granularity' means the legacy model cannot express the fix, which is a limitation to record, not a fix to attempt.

disposition_detail.description: The remedy in specifics: the object to change, or the table and rows, or the mechanism class that cannot be expressed. On 'unsupported', whether a narrower partial fix is feasible AND accurate for every address it would cover -- not merely for the ticket's address.

question_match.description: pass | fail | n/a -- the verdict answers the question the ticket asked.

basis.description: pass | fail | n/a -- every load-bearing claim is measured or traced.

divergence_located.description: pass | fail | n/a -- the first divergence is at an object/line, not a symptom.

alternative_killed.description: pass | fail | n/a -- the competing explanations were ruled out by evidence, not by preference.

scope_stated.description: pass | fail | n/a -- who else is affected: merchants, states, periods, surfaces.

first_divergence.description: The first point where expected and actual diverge — the proc/function or table, and the value on each side.

affected_roots.description: Execution roots the defect reaches (e.g. spTransactionLookup, spImportOfflineTransactions, fnGetTaxRatesforTx_nonssuta). Drives case coverage downstream.

evidence.description: Every load-bearing claim with its basis and citation.

basis.description: measured = a query result (snapshot facts are measured for that dated copy only); traced = read out of code or state-published material; inferred/hedge cannot support a terminal verdict.

citation.description: The query, file path, capture, or published source.

limitation_match.description: The limitations.md mechanism class this matches and the data proving the match, or 'none'. A match is a hypothesis proven from data, never a shortcut past cause analysis.

unknowns.description: What remains unknown, and what would resolve it.

blocking_question.description: The one question a human must answer, or empty. State it here rather than waiting on a reply — no interactive user may be present.
